settings.text: How does Burn2O work?

settings.repere: Texte · Burn2O uses patented liquid thermogenic
settings.text: Burn2O uses patented liquid thermogenic technology to activate your body's fat-burning furnace 24/7. MitoBurn® converts white fat to brown fat for 5.3X more cellular fat burning, while CaloriBurn GP® activates brown adipose tissue for 400% higher metabolic rate. L-Carnitine shuttles fatty acids into mitochondria, and GBB creates the intense "sweat effect" you feel within minutes.

settings.repere: Texte · You'll feel thermogenic effects within 1
settings.text: You'll feel thermogenic effects within 15-30 minutes. GBB creates an intense "sweat effect" that users describe as turning your body into a "walking fat-burning sauna." CaloriBurn GP® activates brown fat within 30 minutes. Unlike other fat burners where you're guessing if they work, you'll literally feel the heat.

settings.text: Which ingredients are in Burn2O?

settings.repere: Texte · Burn2O contains four clinically-dosed, p
settings.text:
Burn2O contains four clinically-dosed, patented ingredients in a delicious liquid formula:

✅ L-Carnitine (2000mg) - Transports fatty acids into mitochondria to be burned as fuel
✅ MitoBurn® (500mg) - Patented L-BAIBA that converts white fat to brown fat for 5.3X more cellular fat burning
✅ CaloriBurn GP® (10mg) - Standardized Grains of Paradise extract that activates brown adipose tissue and raises metabolic rate by 400%
✅ GBB (25mg) - Gamma-butyrobetaine that increases carnitine levels up to 300% and creates intense thermogenesis

Plus natural flavoring, citric acid, and stevia for taste. Zero calories, zero sugar, zero artificial colors. Complete transparency - no proprietary blends or hidden ingredients.
